tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
What the index covers: the vendor categories with how many vendors each has, how many publish a price and
the median published starting price for a whole event; the areas, event types and needs (kosher, MC,
lighting...) the other tools accept. Call it first if you are unsure what the index covers.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description:
Everything the index knows about one vendor: category, areas, bookability score, website, how to book,
and every published fact (starting price and what it covers, packages, deposit, booking lead time,
cancellation policy and more), each with the quote from the vendor's own site, its page and the da

tools.name: compare_vendors
tools.description:
Two to five vendors side by side: starting price and what it covers, areas, event types, deposit, booking
lead time, cancellation policy and how to book, with every fact's source. Use it when a consumer is choosing
between vendors from a search or shortlist.

tools.name: get_price_summary
tools.description:
One service's price: what New York area vendors in one category publish as a starting price for a whole event: the median and
the middle half (25th to 75th percentile), from how many vendors and when, optionally for one area, plus
per-hour or per-guest figures where the category is priced that way.

tools.name: estimate_event_budget
tools.description:

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: list_categories, get_price_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: list_categories, get_price_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
